ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixel coverage against a 70-75% low-intensity (black) background.

The lobe on the right side of the frame features a prominent vertical, crescent-shaped white region. The lobe on the left side of the frame exhibits a more fragmented, circular clustering of light pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with multiple small peaks and valleys along the entire length. A distinct, deep-amplitude notch is visible on the trailing edge of the left-image lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel white linear streaks (rake marks) are detected on the distal half of the right-image lobe, crossing the primary light-pigment patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Combination of dense, overlapping circular scars concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
